content.title: Recurring Threat, Local Inventory Defense | Two Locations and a Route Return
content.summary: Bookend one clearly adult protagonist on a public route, then carry one recurring non-graphic threat through at least two functionally distinct interiors. Foreshadow each location's unique inventory before one different local defensive redirection, preserve identity and travel direction, and return to the original route for a stable ending.

quick_start.input_format: adult protagonist, public route and forward direction + one recurring non-graphic threat across at least two functionally distinct interiors + each local inventory shown before use + materially different local defense in each location + continued movement + stable return to the original public route
quick_start.recommended_input: An adult transit inspector in a maroon coat is followed by one malfunctioning drone from a tram platform into a plant nursery and bicycle workshop. A mist curtain redirects it first; a steel parts bin and wall magnet trap it second. She returns to the original platform with the same badge, direction and calm final gaze.
required_anchors: Establish one adult protagonist, public route and forward movement before the threat appears.
Use one recurring non-graphic threat across at least two functionally distinct interiors.
Use only local inventory for one materially different defensive redirection in each interior, then continue moving.
Return to the opening public route with stable identity, direction, gait and terminal gaze.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.

creative_dna.mechanism: Establish one clearly adult protagonist, public route and forward movement as a bookend carrier. Let one recurring non-graphic threat follow the protagonist into at least two functionally distinct interior locations. In each location, reveal a unique inventory of visible local objects before conflict, then allow the protagonist to use only that location's inventory for one distinct defensive redirection. Preserve the same protagonist, threat identity and travel direction across locations, and return to the original public route after the final defense. End with stable gait and gaze rather than another attack. The reusable mechanism is public-route identity carrier, recurring threat, location inventory foreshadowing, distinct local defense, continuous escape and route return—not the source woman, red hair, white outfit, masked attacker, city, supermarket, cosmetics store, groceries, rainbow fabric, beauty products, broken glass, exact combat, camera, creator identity or model claim.

invariants.rule: Establish one adult protagonist, public route and forward movement before the threat appears.
invariants.purpose: Creates an identity and direction carrier for the bookend.
invariants.ablation_failure: Opening inside conflict removes the route comparison.

invariants.rule: Use one recurring non-graphic threat across at least two functionally distinct interiors.
invariants.purpose: Links the episodes into one pursuit rather than unrelated fights.
invariants.ablation_failure: Different unexplained threats fragment the causal chain.

invariants.rule: Show each location's unique inventory before it becomes part of the defense.
invariants.purpose: Makes environmental use fair and readable.
invariants.ablation_failure: Unseen tools appearing at impact feel arbitrary.

invariants.rule: Use only local inventory for one materially different defensive redirection in each interior, then continue moving.
invariants.purpose: Makes place function drive action variation.
invariants.ablation_failure: Repeating the same generic attack wastes the location change.

invariants.rule: Return to the opening public route with stable identity, direction, gait and terminal gaze.
invariants.purpose: Closes geography and proves continuity after escalation.
invariants.ablation_failure: Ending in another interior leaves the route unresolved.

slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source woman's facial identity, red hair, white blouse and trousers, rainbow garment and exact performance
the source masked black-clad attacker, body design, fight choreography, gestures and recurrence timing
the source city crosswalk, supermarket shelves, groceries, produce, cosmetics counters, beauty products and broken glass
the source floating-object VFX, camera moves, store order, action beats, framing and final portrait
the source creator identity, GPT still-image claim, Seedance 2.0 claim, platform overlay, watermark and branding
